video_caption: The video segment opens with a romantic close-up of Simone Biles kissing her husband, Jonathan Owens, who is wearing a Green Bay Packers jersey, with "2023 BACK THAT YEAR UP" visible in the background. An off-screen voice asks who is the better athlete. Simone Biles, wearing a teal collared shirt and an "OWENS" necklace, responds that they are both good at their own sports. The scene transitions to a football player in a dark blue uniform running on a field with cheerleaders, followed by Simone Biles performing complex flips on the uneven bars in a red leotard, with the text "NFL AND GYMNASTICS. WHICH IS HARDER, ACTUALLY?" overlayed. She is then shown in a pink t-shirt with a gold medal, smiling in a gym. A split screen shows Simone Biles speaking to Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson, stating her husband "could barely do" her gym workout. Subsequent clips show Biles in various leotards performing gymnastics routines, preparing with chalk, and doing a split on a bar. The video implies she "crushed" her husband's NFL workout, suggesting she's claiming gymnastics is harder or she is more versatile. The segment concludes with Biles smiling next to her muscular husband, Jonathan Owens, in two different outfits, with the text "But the argument aside."

The video begins with a man in a light-colored suit and a woman in a white dress laughing joyfully at what appears to be a formal event, with white floral arrangements visible in the foreground. This transitions to a football player in a white number 87 jersey celebrating with teammates on a field in a packed stadium, with the text "TEXAN GAME IN 2019" displayed. Next, a framed image shows the man and woman sitting together in a stadium, the man wearing a brown patterned shirt and the woman a black blazer, with the text "DATING APP RAYA" overlayed. The woman then appears in a close-up, speaking while wearing a light turtleneck sweater and long braids, against a blurred city background. The couple is seen again, smiling together in a stadium, followed by an aerial night shot of a city with brightly lit buildings. A woman in a grey and white striped t-shirt is then shown holding a white mug and looking at her smartphone by a window. The man and woman walk hand-in-hand across a grassy area, both smiling, the man in a white t-shirt and the woman in a black cropped hoodie and leggings, after which the woman is seen walking alone on the grass, still smiling. The video concludes with an aerial view of an airport filled with parked airplanes, presented with a purple and pink color filter.

The video segment features various clips related to Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens. It opens with Simone Biles, a Black woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless top with the number "36" and white shorts, standing next to Jonathan Owens, a Black man with braided dark hair, wearing a white and blue patterned shirt and white pants, as they smile and hold hands in an outdoor event space. This transitions to Simone Biles performing a split on a balance beam, viewed from above, in a patriotic leotard. She then appears smiling in a red sweatshirt with "#nocompetition" (hashtag no competition) on a red background with "VS" (versus) and "SK-II STUDIO" (SK-II STUDIO) text. Next, Biles and another woman in black tops are interviewed in a gym. A scene follows showing three bulldogs, one black and white, one blue-merle, and one tan, lying on a carpet. The video then shows a close-up of Biles and Owens, eyes closed and smiling, with yellow text overlaying: "WE KIND OF HAD THAT TIME TO OURSELVES, SEE IF WE LIKE EACH OTHER. AND IT KIND OF WORKED." Biles then speaks, smiling, with yellow text at the bottom: "WE KIND OF WERE JUST LIKE MAGNETS." Another shot shows Owens hugging Biles from behind, both smiling, surrounded by pink and red balloons. Owens is then seen speaking in a black hoodie, with yellow text appearing: "WE JUST KIND OF STARTED HANGING OUT MORE AND MORE AND YOU START TO WANT TO SEE A PERSON." The video cuts to Biles in a gym, holding a duffel bag, with multiple screens displaying gymnasts behind her. Finally, Biles, wearing a red hat, holds two French bulldogs while smiling at the camera.

The video opens with a close-up shot of a delicate gold ring featuring a prominent central diamond and several smaller diamonds along the band, resting on a soft, blurred red surface, possibly a rose petal or velvet. This transitions to a scene where a man with braided hair, dressed in a grey suit jacket and black turtleneck, is kneeling on one knee, holding a small box and smiling up at a woman in a black mini-dress, who is laughing joyfully with her hands clasped together, suggesting a proposal in an outdoor gazebo setting. The next shot shows the same couple standing close together outdoors in front of a red helicopter; the man, wearing a white t-shirt, smiles directly at the camera, while the woman in a dark top leans into him, looking down with a gentle smile. Finally, the video shows the couple celebrating at an evening event, likely a wedding reception, surrounded by smiling guests; the man is in a white suit jacket holding a white cup, and the woman, in a light-colored dress, smiles while holding a white handheld fan, with her arm around the man as they dance or mingle.

The video features a series of short clips depicting a couple's engagement and their affection. It opens with a man, sporting dreadlocks and wearing a light grey suit with a black turtleneck, kneeling on one knee, holding a ring box, proposing to a woman in a black mini-dress and high heels. She covers her mouth and laughs in surprise and joy. Overlaying this scene, on a crumpled paper background, is the text: "I CAN'T WAIT TO SPEND FOREVER & EVER WITH YOU, YOU'RE EVERYTHING I DREAMED OF AND MORE!" (English). The scene then transitions to the man, now in a black hoodie, sitting in the plush interior of a vehicle, picking up a water bottle and smiling at the camera. This is followed by a close-up of the couple, with the woman having long braids and wearing a strapless top, smiling softly at the camera, while the man, with shorter hair, rests his head on her shoulder and also smiles. Text overlaid here reads: "Jonathan, on the other hand, couldn't help but brag how he woke up that morning, the day after Valentine's with a Fiance." (English). The video then cuts back to the proposal scene, where the woman reaches out to touch the man's face as he smiles up at her. Accompanying text appears: "In the same post, he thanked a friend for helping him plan the" (English), before abruptly cutting to a shot of the now-standing couple. The man, still in his grey suit but now with a cast on his left arm, has his arm around the woman, and both are smiling broadly, with the woman's hands covering her mouth in an expression of ecstatic surprise.

The video opens with a close-up shot of a person looking at a smartphone displaying a social media feed. This transitions to a smiling photo of Olympic gymnast Simone Biles, wearing a green dress, standing next to her husband, Jonathan Owens, in a white shirt, in front of a building. The next image shows the couple in a car, holding up a "MARRIAGE LICENSE" from "THE STATE OF TEXAS," both beaming at the camera. They are then seen in a courthouse, dressed in formal wedding attire (Biles in a white tiered dress, Owens in a light suit), holding hands as a minister officiates their ceremony. An exterior shot of the "HARRIS COUNTY CIVIL COURTHOUSE" follows. Simone Biles then appears in an interview, first in a yellow top, then in a white hoodie in a gym setting, where a text overlay reads: "WE HAD TO GET MARRIED 'LEGALLY' HERE IN THE US- SINCE OUR WEDDING WILL BE A DESTINATION WEDDING." (English: "WE HAD TO GET MARRIED 'LEGALLY' HERE IN THE US- SINCE OUR WEDDING WILL BE A DESTINATION WEDDING."). The video cuts back to the couple, now in their wedding outfits, joyfully exiting a building, with Owens raising an arm in celebration and Biles holding a white bouquet. This is followed by a dynamic sequence of Simone Biles performing gymnastics in a sparkling red leotard, showcasing a backbend and a handstand on a beam. Another professional photo of the couple shows Biles looking at Owens, who is embracing her from behind; both wear white t-shirts and jeans, and Biles's wedding ring is visible. The video returns to Biles speaking in an interview, then talking into multiple microphones held by reporters. The segment concludes with Biles, in a white bikini top and sheer cover-up, and Owens, in a white t-shirt and patterned swim shorts, walking and smiling by a swimming pool in a tropical setting.

The video montage begins with a still photograph of a man in a light suit and a woman in a beige dress posing outdoors by the ocean, followed by various scenes from a wedding ceremony and reception in Cabo, Mexico, as indicated by the on-screen text "CABO, MEXICO." The couple, an NFL safety and a seven-time Olympic medalist gymnast, exchange vows, with the man in a white suit and the woman in a white wedding gown and veil, smiling and embracing, and at one point, she holds a small booklet labeled "Vows." Subsequent shots show the bride walking down an aisle with an older man in a green suit, a wide view of the ceremony on a platform overlooking a beach and the ocean with white floral arches, and the groom playfully lifting and spinning the bride during a celebratory moment. Decorative elements like a golden 'S' centerpiece and monogrammed napkins are shown. Interspersed are scenic shots of ocean waves and a sunset, which then transition to a striking visual of numerous black whales beached on a shore, with several people attempting to push them back into the water. The video returns to the wedding, displaying yellow text that reads, "IT SPRINKLED FOR TWO MINUTES AFTER WE GOT MARRIED- WHICH IS GOOD LUCK!--AND WE HAD A FULL MOON." and a nighttime shot of a full moon through tree branches, before concluding with the newlyweds slow dancing at their outdoor reception amidst guests.

The video opens with a woman in a white, sleeveless wedding gown with a high leg slit, posing playfully in a modern hotel room, extending one leg in a white high-heeled shoe towards the camera (0:00-0:06). The next shot shows the same woman and a man, both in white formal attire, jumping on a white carpeted aisle at a beach wedding ceremony, with white floral arches in the background, as the text "MR. & MRS. OWEN" appears at the bottom (0:06-0:09). A close-up of the woman, with dark hair and bright makeup, smiling widely (0:09-0:10), transitions to her from behind, wearing a white silky top with feathered cuffs, holding a champagne flute and looking out at a beach with palm trees from a balcony (0:10-0:13). The scene then cuts to a "VANITY FAIR" magazine cover featuring "SIMONE BILES" in a pink strapless dress, with the tagline "The Sky's the Limit" (0:13-0:16). The woman and man, dressed formally, are seen outdoors at night, smiling and raising their hands amidst a backdrop of dazzling fireworks (0:16-0:20). Indoors, the woman in a white blazer and pants is surrounded by several other women, all in similar satin pajama-like outfits with feathered cuffs, laughing and posing together (0:20-0:23). Following this, Simone Biles is shown in a blue and white sparkly gymnastics leotard, first bending over on a mat, then smiling and raising her arms in a gym, with the superimposed yellow text "I WAS 19 WHEN I WON MY FIRST OLYMPICS, AND I WAS LIKE, HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO TOP THIS?" (0:23-0:29). An Instagram post from "simonebiles" (verified with a blue checkmark) is displayed, dated "46w" ago, reading: "a look into our most special day ❤ I love being able to relive this day over & over. Thank you @irisfilmsatl for capturing our love!" (0:29-0:33). Finally, Simone Biles is shown sitting in a red, long-sleeved, sparkly gymnastics leotard, adjusting her hair in a high bun, with various sponsor logos like FUJITSU, Lotto, and Sporza on the white background behind her (0:33-0:37).

The video opens with Simone Biles in a gymnastics practice, wearing a black and red leotard and shorts, bending over on a mat while looking towards the camera, with other gymnasts and a balance beam visible in the background, which has "AVAI" written on it. This transitions to a photo of her in a light green dress with long dark hair against a brown background, framed by crumpled white paper. Next, she is seen speaking in a light-colored turtleneck, her hair in braids, in what appears to be an interview setting with a blurred outdoor background. The scene then shifts to her performing gymnastics: first a backflip on a blue mat in an arena with an American flag banner and "NBC Sports" logo, then a vault from a springboard with a sparkly black leotard and a blurred audience, where an "xfinity" logo is also seen. Following this, she is shown at a press conference, wearing a white jacket, a white face mask with "USA" written on it, and Olympic medals, with various sponsor logos like "SAMSUNG" and "TOYOTA" in the background, and "Simone BILES" on the table. The video then shows her in a television studio, with braids and a light-colored turtleneck, speaking to a male interviewer, against a backdrop of the Brooklyn Bridge and city skyline, with "MORNING NEW" (Morning News) visible on the desk. Finally, she is seen smiling broadly in a red "TEXANS" cheerleading uniform, holding pom-poms on a football field.

The video showcases a montage of a female gymnast, likely Simone Biles based on the accompanying text, performing and receiving awards. Initially, she is seen practicing in a light pink leotard with a cherry blossom design, stretching her arms in a gym. This transitions to a shot of her (or another gymnast named Katelyn Jong, according to the scoreboard) executing a spin on a balance beam during a competition, with spectators visible in the background and an "NBC Sports" logo. A white text box then appears on a crumpled paper background, stating: "Simone Biles finishes with four golds at 2023 Gymnastics World Championships". The video then shows the gymnast with a thoughtful expression in a blue leotard adorned with red and white stars, followed by a shot of her smiling in a blue shirt in front of an American flag, displaying numerous gold, silver, and bronze medals. She is next seen performing a powerful vault in a bright pink leotard, landing gracefully. The montage concludes with her smiling while wearing a "TEAM USA" tracksuit, adorned with multiple gold medals around her neck, standing on a podium in front of a white wall filled with sponsor logos and "#STUTTGART2019," followed by a brief shot of a woman in a red dress and a man in a light suit walking outdoors.

The video opens with a white, crumpled paper-like background featuring a black rectangular text box containing the title, "Kudos to My Wife": After Constant Backlash, Jonathan Owens Attributes Simone Biles' Humility to His Unawareness Debate. The scene then shifts to a medium close-up of a man with braided hair, a beard, an earring, and a white patch on his cheek, speaking in front of a blurred background. A bright purple and white light appears, with a hand reaching out towards it. Next, a man in a Green Bay Packers football helmet and green jersey is shown, looking serious. This is followed by a shot of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a light-colored ribbed dress, sitting in a red armchair, speaking, with a projector beside her. The next frame shows four gymnasts in red, white, and blue "USA" leotards, some wearing black masks, embracing and consoling each other in an arena with the word "TOKYO" visible. Children wearing face masks excitedly wave signs, one of which reads "I ❤️ BILES & CHILES USA WE [USA flag]", in what appears to be an airport or large hall. A woman in a pink top is seen stretching her arm in a gym, followed by a close-up of her ankle as she adjusts a red and black ankle weight, and then a full shot of her leaping with the weights. A group of people, including a woman in a white "Team USA" sweatshirt and mask, walk past a cameraman. The video cuts to a woman with her hair pulled back, wearing a sparkly high-necked dress, smiling over her shoulder on what looks like a red carpet. She is then seen interacting with two young girls, while a police officer stands behind them. Large banners featuring gymnasts performing are displayed on a building wall. A man and a woman, both wearing matching red, green, and white plaid pajamas, stand together and smile. A blue A-frame sign on a street reads "STOP THE SPREAD! 2 METERS. KEEP 2 METERS BETWEEN YOU AND ANYONE YOU SEE." Finally, the video shows a woman in a black sparkly leotard performing a gymnastics routine in an arena filled with spectators, then back to the couple in pajamas, and then a man in a blue football jersey with the number "36" and "TEXANS" on it walks on a field. The video concludes with a close-up of the man in a white collared shirt, smiling widely.

The video opens with a medium close-up of an African American man with short dreadlocks, a beard, and wearing a black hoodie, speaking into several microphones held by unseen reporters. He is in what appears to be a locker room with wooden lockers behind him. The man is talking animatedly, with a serious but engaged expression. The scene then transitions to a wide shot of a large indoor arena with a vast audience, where an African American female gymnast in a purple leotard is performing a vault. She runs, springs off a springboard, and performs a series of flips and twists over the vaulting table, landing gracefully on the mat. A male coach in a red shirt stands nearby, watching her intently. Text on a scoreboard in the background shows "Jordan Chiles" and scores: "DIF: 5.000, EXEC: 8.300, ND: 0.00, TOTAL: 13.300." Following this, a static image appears of the man from the beginning of the video, wearing a black t-shirt and gold chain, smiling and standing next to an African American woman with long dark hair, wearing a white hoodie and holding a pink rose. They are indoors, with a framed picture on the wall behind them. Overlaid text states, "FIRST TIME GETTING TO WATCH YOU COMPETE IN PERSON AND YOU DIDN'T DISAPPOINT... I'M SO PROUD OF YOU MY LIL CHAMP." (This text is a direct quote from the man, expressing his pride in the woman's performance.) The video then cuts to a slightly blurry shot of the same woman, wearing a white tank top and a light blue face mask pulled down below her chin, looking forward with a serious expression. A man in a dark grey t-shirt with a "Insurance Industry Charitable Foundation" logo is partially visible beside her. This scene is in an indoor recreational setting with a net visible in the background. The man from the beginning is then shown clearly, wearing the same dark grey t-shirt with the logo, standing near the woman and looking ahead with a focused expression. He is wearing a grey shirt tied around his neck. Finally, the video displays a full-body shot of the man in a green football jersey with the number "34" on it, yellow shorts, and green gloves, running on a green grass field during what appears to be a practice session. He is looking to his left, in motion.

The video segment opens with a blurred shot of a football stadium, where a man in a green and yellow football jersey with "OWENS" and "41" on the back smiles over his shoulder as a dark-skinned woman with long dark hair, wearing a white shirt, smiles brightly at him. This transitions to a still image of the same smiling couple on the field, with the man in a green #3 jersey, overlaid with a graphic of a tweet from "Simone Biles (@Simone_Biles)" that reads, "I'M SO EXCITED ABOUT NOT HAVING A CONNECTING FLIGHT TO GO & SEE MY HUSBAND hahahahaha" (English: "I'M SO EXCITED ABOUT NOT HAVING A CONNECTING FLIGHT TO GO & SEE MY HUSBAND hahahahaha"). Subsequent scenes show intimate moments between the couple: a close-up of them snuggled on a couch, both smiling; a picture of the shirtless man embracing the laughing woman on a beach, with yellow text overlaid saying, "SO INCREDIBLY PROUD OF MY HUSBAND. THE GRIND NEVER STOPS! THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING."; and a black and white image of them walking hand-in-hand on the beach, looking at each other. The woman is then shown in a black and white close-up, looking contemplative, followed by another beach photo where the man in a light-colored outfit playfully lifts the woman in a white dress. A close-up of their hands intertwined, showcasing the woman's diamond ring, precedes a graphic of an Instagram post from "jowens" that says, "Happy birthday to the most beautiful soul, my amazing wife. So crazy to me how life aligns you with the person that you're meant to be with, you've made me a better man in so many ways i can't explain it. My heart, my rock and my best friend all in one. I love you so much baby, this is going to be a special year for you and i can't wait to support you every step along the way ❤️". The video then shows a smiling photo of the couple in front of twinkling lights, followed by clips of the man in a white suit, smiling in an outdoor setting with palm trees and a fire pit, and then speaking on a video call next to the woman. The man is later seen in a close-up, wearing a dark hoodie and speaking, with yellow text overlaying his image, stating, "I CAN'T WAIT TO SUPPORT YOU EVERY STEP ALONG THE WAY." The woman, in a light-colored ribbed dress, is shown speaking from an armchair, and the man in the white suit appears briefly again. The segment concludes with Simone Biles, in a red sparkly leotard and black face mask, standing with other gymnasts in an arena near a balance beam.
